question: The distance of the Sun from the Earth is about _________ light minutes.
solution:
The Correct Answer is __8__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Light from the sun takes 8 minutes16.6 seconds to reach the Earth.
 
• The Earth takes about** 365.25** days to complete one full revolution around the Sun. This period is called a year.
 
• The Earth's axis of rotation is tilted by 23.5 degrees
 
• The Moon orbits Earth in one revolution in about 27.32 days.
 
• Venus makes a complete orbit around the Sun in 225 Earth days.
 
• Jupiter makes a complete orbit around the Sun in about 12 Earth years.
 
• Light travels at a speed of 299,792 kilometres per second; 186,287 miles per second.
 
• It takes 499.0 seconds for light to travel from the Sun to the Earth, a distance called 1 Astronomical Unit.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1a2751b018c6ed8577271816183074d5a6cbc8c5eba3aab87228b93790647fca.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Sunlight an average of 8 minutes and 20 seconds to travel from the Sun to the Earth.
 
• Photons emitted from the Sun travel across the vacuum of space to reach earth.
 
• The distance between the sun and Earth is 149.6 million km.
 
• The Sun’s corona is the outermost part of the Sun’s atmosphere.
 
 
• It is hidden by the bright light of the Sun's surface, it can be viewed during a total solar eclipse.
 
• The corona reaches extremely high temperatures.
 
 
 
• The surface of the Sun is covered in magnetic fields.
